subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and the merged key-free opt-in PR all treat this as an operator-controlled outbound routing decision, so automation should not decide the default policy.

options.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Keep DuckDuckGo selectable only through tools.web.search.provider or configure flows, and solve the UX gap with diagnostics or setup guidance.

options.title: Approve Keyless Fallback
options.body: Allow implicit keyless fallback only with aligned runtime metadata, setup behavior, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause Linked PR
options.body: Leave the candidate PR unmerged until a maintainer sponsors the provider-routing direction.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
recommendation.body: Keep DuckDuckGo selectable only through tools.web.search.provider or configure flows, and solve the UX gap with diagnostics or setup guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy that this issue asks to reverse.
